Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

`DraftBackendFactory` builds EAGLE draft attention backends only from a closed in-tree map. An attention backend that an out-of-tree (OOT) platform or plugin registers with `register_attention_backend` therefore cannot serve the draft of EAGLE-family speculative decoding (including NEXTN / MTP) on the built-in worker; the factory raises `EAGLE is not supported in attention backend ...`.

This is part of generic OOT speculative-decoding support: a platform that runs the built-in EAGLE worker with its own attention kernels needs a way to provide the draft backends, and plugins that patch the factory today can drop that patch. A name-keyed registry matches how OOT platforms already contribute their main attention backends.

## Modifications

- `attention_registry.register_draft_attention_backend(name)` / `DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS`, mirroring `register_attention_backend` / `ATTENTION_BACKENDS`. The factory is called as `fn(runner=, topk=, speculative_num_steps=)` and returns a multi-step container exposing `attn_backends`.
- `DraftBackendFactory._create_backend`: built-in names are looked up first, unchanged. A name with a registered draft factory is built from it for draft decode and from the regular `ATTENTION_BACKENDS` factory of the same name for draft extend, stamped with that name. Registering the draft factory is the opt-in: a backend without one keeps the existing error.
- Docs: the plugin guide shows how to register a draft backend.

## Accuracy Tests

No change for built-in attention backends (the in-tree map is consulted first).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Tests

Added to `TestDraftFactoryStamping` in `test/registered/unit/test_split_attention_backend_decisions.py` (CPU):

- a registered backend serves both draft phases with the right factory arguments, and the container, its per-step children and the extend backend carry its stamp (fails without this change);
- a backend registered only with `register_attention_backend` still gets the existing error.

```
pytest test/registered/unit/test_split_attention_backend_decisions.py test/registered/unit/spec/
# 319 passed
```

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -318,6 +318,26 @@ Every public name on the subclass (and on any mixin it composes) must exist on
 defined, so a hook that core renamed or never had raises `TypeError` naming it
 instead of silently never being called.
 
+Attention backends are registered by name and selected with
+`--attention-backend` (or `get_default_attention_backend()`). To serve the draft
+of EAGLE-family speculative decoding (including NEXTN / MTP) on the built-in
+worker, also register a multi-step draft decode backend under the same name;
+draft extend reuses the regular factory:
+
+```python
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.attention_registry import (
+    register_attention_backend,
+    register_draft_attention_backend,
+)
+
+@register_attention_backend("my_attn")
+def create_my_attn_backend(runner): ...
+
+@register_draft_attention_backend("my_attn")
+def create_my_attn_draft_backend(runner, topk, speculative_num_steps):
+    ...  # returns a container exposing `attn_backends`, one per draft step
+```
+
 **6. Install and verify:**
 
 ```bash

@@ -39,6 +39,7 @@
     from sglang.srt.model_executor.model_runner import ModelRunner
 
 ATTENTION_BACKENDS = {}
+DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS = {}
 HYBRID_GDN_SM100_BACKENDS = {"triton", "trtllm_mha", "fa4", "flashinfer"}
 
 
@@ -50,6 +51,22 @@ def decorator(fn):
     return decorator
 
 
+def register_draft_attention_backend(name):
+    """Register the multi-step draft decode backend for attention backend ``name``.
+
+    The factory is called as ``fn(runner=, topk=, speculative_num_steps=)`` and
+    returns a container exposing ``attn_backends`` (one per draft step). The
+    draft extend backend comes from the ``register_attention_backend`` factory
+    of the same name.
+    """
+
+    def decorator(fn):
+        DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS[name] = fn
+        return fn
+
+    return decorator
+
+
 @register_attention_backend("flashinfer")
 def create_flashinfer_backend(runner):

+        elif backend_type in DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS:

+        else:
+            raise ValueError(error_template.format(backend_type=backend_type))
         if backend is not None:
             if stamps_children:
                 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.attention_registry import (
@@ -81,6 +90,20 @@ def _create_backend(
                     child.decode_attention_backend_str = stamp
         return backend
 
+    def _create_registered_backend(self, *, backend_type: str, multi_step: bool):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.attention_registry import (
+            ATTENTION_BACKENDS,
+            DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS,
+        )
+
+        if multi_step:
+            return DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS[backend_type](
+                runner=self.draft_model_runner,
+                topk=self.topk,
+                speculative_num_steps=self.speculative_num_steps,
+            )
+        return ATTENTION_BACKENDS[backend_type](self.draft_model_runner)
+
     def create_decode_backend(self):
         # No multi-step draft backend for steps=0 (nospec) or steps=1.
         if self.speculative_num_steps <= 1:

@@ -282,6 +282,60 @@ def test_a_host_dependent_alias_stamps_the_concrete_kernel(self):
             product.attn_backends[0].decode_attention_backend_str, "triton"
         )
 
+    def test_a_registered_backend_serves_both_draft_phases(self):
+        # An out-of-tree backend opts into EAGLE drafts by registering a draft
+        # factory; draft extend reuses its regular factory of the same name.
+        from types import SimpleNamespace
+        from unittest import mock
+
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention import attention_registry
+
+        self._publish(attention_backend="triton")
+        factory = self._factory(draft_backend="oot_attn")
+        children = [SimpleNamespace(), SimpleNamespace()]
+        container = SimpleNamespace(attn_backends=children)
+        extend_backend = SimpleNamespace()
+        draft_fn = mock.Mock(return_value=container)
+        with (
+            mock.patch.dict(
+                attention_registry.DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKENDS, oot_attn=draft_fn
+            ),
+            mock.patch.dict(
+                attention_registry.ATTENTION_BACKENDS,
+                oot_attn=lambda runner: extend_backend,
+            ),
+        ):
+            decode = factory._create_backend(
+                "decode_attention_backend",
+                {},
+                "unsupported {backend_type}",
+                stamps_children=True,
+            )
+            extend = factory._create_backend(
+                "prefill_attention_backend", {}, "unsupported {backend_type}"
+            )
+        draft_fn.assert_called_once_with(
+            runner=factory.draft_model_runner, topk=1, speculative_num_steps=2
+        )
+        self.assertIs(extend, extend_backend)
+        for obj in [decode, *children, extend]:
+            self.assertEqual(obj.prefill_attention_backend_str, "oot_attn")
+            self.assertEqual(obj.decode_attention_backend_str, "oot_attn")
+
+    def test_a_backend_without_a_draft_factory_keeps_the_error(self):
+        from unittest import mock
+
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention import attention_registry
+
+        self._publish(attention_backend="triton")
+        with mock.patch.dict(
+            attention_registry.ATTENTION_BACKENDS, oot_attn=lambda runner: None
+        ):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "unsupported oot_attn"):
+                self._factory(draft_backend="oot_attn")._create_backend(
+                    "prefill_attention_backend", {}, "unsupported {backend_type}"
+                )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
